groups.saying_opens: كم من دار سكنها ناس فهلكوا

notes: «ابنى عبد الله بن عمر» after حمزة وسالم is an apposition naming their father, not a separate link; the Companion is the last link
second saying: Malik's explanation read to al-Harith (Abu Dawud present) and related by Ibn al-Qasim; Malik is its last link
Abu Dawud's bare «قال عمر ... حصير» has no transmitter; not written as a group
